remarks: Beautifully updated and bathed in natural light, this rare and spacious residence at the sought-after Whitby Condominiums offers a spectacular, multi-level layout. The heart of the home features a seamless, open-concept kitchen and living area anchored by a cozy fireplace. Looking up, the versatile upstairs loft offers an airy, open feel, gazing directly down into the living room-making it the ultimate backdrop for a home office, den, or guest space. The main-floor primary bedroom boasts ample closet space, while premium perks include in-unit laundry, reserved parking, a dedicated storage unit, and secure elevator access. Perfectly situated in a prime Mid-City location, you are just moments from vibrant dining, shopping, the Metro-North, and Stamford Hospital. Walk to absolutely everything!
